## What problem does it solve

Describe the situation where the app falls short. "I want X" is fine, but the
why helps to prioritise.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine the feature working inside the app.

## Alternatives

Any other approach you considered, or how you solve it today.

## Additional context

Screenshots, sketches or examples from other apps are welcome.
